concerns_addressed: Implementer concern 'README mentions ce init which only lands in later task T5 of the same PR' - confirmed plan-intended (plan T1 step 3 and spec D6 require the Quick start; ce init is added by T5 in the same PR). Not a T1 spec defect; recorded as Minor in stage_2.

strengths: tsconfig.build.json extends ./tsconfig.json and excludes the four required globs; it also keeps node_modules and dist, the defaults an explicit exclude would otherwise drop (tsconfig.json has no exclude of its own).
Scratch build with outDir outside the repo emits 243 files with zero test, testsupport, arbitraries or scripts artifacts; dist/cli.js starts with #!/usr/bin/env node.

No non-test module imports a testsupport, arbitraries or scripts module. Every runtime bare import (including the dynamic playwright import) is declared in dependencies; devDependencies ajv, fast-check, vitest and tsx are not imported at runtime.
npm pack --workspace continuous-evidence --dry-run: 246 files, zero test-like paths, dist/cli.js, README.md, LICENSE and package.json present; no .tgz left; git status clean.

package-manifest.test.ts: 16/16 pass. Assertions are exact equality on repository, homepage, bugs, version 0.1.0, files ['dist'], bin, build, prepack and typecheck, so a regression in any of them fails the test. LICENSE is checked byte-for-byte against the root LICENSE.

typecheck still uses full tsconfig.json (tsc --noEmit). Root npm run typecheck exits 0 (covers the action workspace too); full packages/ce vitest run passes 233 files / 1371 tests. Root npm run build was not run because it rewrites tracked action/dist; the scratch-dir tsc build with tsconfig.build.json stands in for it. Action workspace tests were not run.
The action/ bundle is unaffected: action/vitest.config.ts alias and action/tsconfig.json paths resolve continuous-evidence from packages/ce/src, not dist.
Diff touches exactly the five in-scope files, does not edit action/ or the run pipeline, does not publish, and the commit message matches the plan.

issues.description: README Quick start documents 'npx ce init' and 'npx continuous-evidence init', but 'init' is not registered until T5 in this same PR. Plan-intended per T1 step 3 and spec D6; acceptable at T1, but the PR must not merge unless T5 is included.

README.md contract test only checks that the file exists. A regression that drops the Quick start or the bare 'npx ce' warning would still pass. The packet's test intent asks only for existence, so this is a strength gap, not a spec miss.

Packet must-have 'tests written before implementation' cannot be verified: the test and the implementation land together in the single commit 6b7fc3f, and log.json has no T1 RED or FAIL record (only the task entry at phases[0].tasks[0]). Implementer should attest the RED step or record it in log.json.
